title: 50agents vs Zapier: a sourced comparison | 50agents
description: Zapier connects 10,541+ apps, with code steps and AI agents; 50agents builds automations, AI agents and apps from plain words. Every row sourced.
answer: Pick Zapier if you need its 10,541+ apps, code steps in JavaScript or Python, and mature admin controls such as SCIM.
Pick 50agents if you would rather describe the job in plain words and get an automation, AI agent, browser agent or app built and tested for you; it is free to start.
ask: Set up an automation: every new HubSpot contact is added as a row to my Google Sheet and posted in a Slack channel
lede: Zapier is the bigger, older and more complete tool; 50agents starts from a different place, plain words, and asks before anything reaches people outside.

us: You can say what you want but have never built a Zap, or the person who needs it is not the person who builds them.
The job needs judgement each run (an AI agent), a website with no app (a browser agent) or records of its own (an app).
You want every send to a customer to wait for your approval by default.
them: An app you depend on is in Zapier's 10,541+ and not in 50agents' 2,300+.
You want to write code steps in JavaScript or Python.
You need SCIM and role-based access for a large team.

move.title: Start with one Zap
move.body: Pick a Zap that runs often. Write what it does as a sentence: "every new HubSpot contact is added as a row to my Google Sheet and posted in a Slack channel".

move.title: Give that sentence to Captain
move.body: Captain asks which sheet and which channel, shows the steps and the test on your latest contact, and waits for you to make it live.

move.title: Run both for a week
move.body: Leave the Zap on, compare the rows and messages each day, then turn the Zap off. Team and Enterprise accounts can also export the Zap as JSON for their records.

faqs.a: It depends on what runs. Zapier counts every action step as a task, so long Zaps that run often cost the most. 50agents is free to start, and for a short Zap that runs rarely, Zapier's free plan may be enough.

faqs.q: Does 50agents connect to the same apps as Zapier?
faqs.a: Many of them. 50agents works with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket; Zapier lists 10,541+. Check your apps first.

faqs.q: Can I import my Zaps into 50agents?
faqs.a: No. Describe each Zap to Captain instead; it rebuilds it and tests it on your data before you make it live.
